t: The Blazing Infuser improves Blazing Rods made by the $(l:rftoolsbase:powergeneration/blazingagitator)Blazing Agitator$(/l). It consumes catalyst items to increase rod power, duration, or both.
烈焰注能器可提升$(l:rftoolsbase:powergeneration/blazingagitator)烈焰激活器$(/l)产出的充能烈焰棒性能。它消耗催化剂物品，以增强烈焰棒的功率、持续时间，或二者兼得。
After infusion, a rod can no longer help improve other rods in the Agitator. First make a good booster set, then infuse rods intended for fuel.
注魔完成后，该棒材将无法再协助提升搅拌器中其他棒材的性能。请先配制一套优质增效组合，再对计划用作燃料的棒材进行注魔。
Catalysts for a full stack: redstone gives power, quartz gives duration, glowstone favors duration, dimensional shards improve both, and ghast tears or nether stars give large boosts.
一整叠催化剂的配比为：红石增强功率，石英增强持续时间，荧光石偏向增强持续时间，维度碎片可同时提升二者，幽灵泪或下界之星则带来大幅加成。
